caption: The drawing depicts a single wall-mounted mirror with a tall, rectangular shape and a decorative, ornate wooden frame. The frame is brown with a wood grain texture, and it becomes more elaborate and curved at the top, featuring scrollwork and a central, upward-pointing crest. Inside the mirror, at the top section, there are light blue, shell-like decorative motifs that line up horizontally. The main mirror area is shaded light blue to indicate reflection, with subtle diagonal lines suggesting glass. The background of the drawing is a solid, beige color, and there are no additional objects or elements present apart from the framed mirror.
title: Mirror
